title: CSV output follows RFC 4180
text: Fields are comma-separated, quoted when they contain a comma, quote or newline; quotes are doubled; lines end with CRLF.

title: Column selection and order
text: Columns appear in the order given by --columns, or schema order when omitted. An unknown column name is a usage error (exit 2).

history.reason: Order must follow --columns, not schema order; finance relies on a fixed layout.

title: Bounded memory while exporting
text: Peak RSS stays under 256 MB for any report size.

title: Progress on stderr
text: With --progress, a row counter is written to stderr at most once per second.

title: Excel opens UTF-8 exports correctly
text: Non-ASCII characters display correctly when the file is opened in Excel on Windows. (BOM default pending the human's answer.)
